context:
Goal: no repeated run for the same change: "max efficiency with no waste and remaining accurate" (your 20:17 CST Nov 14 goal).
Problem (rule): the lane lint is not carried across a clean merge of main, though the review record is (your ruling 2026-11-10 14:07 CST, pr-review-record line 78). Each time main moves, runner 10 merges main and runs the lane lint again. Carrying it would widen a check, so it needs your word.
Based on (measured): runner 10's read (20:31 CST Nov 14, evening logs; unverified by triage): 6 lints ran only because a clean merge of main moved the head (#3318 9 min, #3426 8, #3429 8, #3400 11, #3367 12, #3427 8) = 56 min, and a 7th (#3435) was running. Three lints at once cost 3 to 4 min each over the 8 min alone (n=2). Lints that were the first at the final head are not counted.
Based on (read): the review-carries-by-tree lane's read of merge/merge.py at main 90feff981bfc (unverified by triage): lint_check takes claim_only commits, not main merges, so the lint reads the exact head today.
Based on (ruling): own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a (your answer a, 21:01 CST Nov 13, relayed by the consultant): the merge skips lane lint when the head's all-jobs-passed check is green. Triage read the ruling, not the merge code. Unknown: whether the 6 lints above ran before a green all-jobs-passed check existed on the moved head; if they did, that ruling does not cover them.
Departs from: main — the lane lint reads the exact head only; option a adds the form "equal tree plus a clean merge of main" to the lint's carry.
Meanwhile: runner 10 keeps one lint per final head and merges main once, as ordered. The coordinator recommends b (named 20:31 CST).

options.gain: No 8 to 12 min lint after each move of main (6 lints and 56 min this evening).
options.label: Carry the lane lint across a clean merge of main; the merge tool proves it: two parents, the second on main, the tree equals git's own merge, nothing else changed
options.lose: The lint's pass then covers a tree it never ran on; batch CI and the PR's own run still run it. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

options.gain: The check stays as narrow as main today.
options.label: Leave the lane lint exact-head
options.lose: About 56 min of runner time per evening at this pace (6 to 7 lints; n=1 evening).

short: Should the lane lint be carried across a clean merge of main?
title: The lane lint runs again every time main moves, 6 times and 56 min this evening. Carry it across a clean merge of main (a), or keep it exact-head (b)?
why: Only you can widen a check's verdict beyond the act your rulings name.
